chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, from Yahya ibn Ubada al-Makki, who said:

I heard Sufyan al-Thawri asking him about al-takhdir, so he said: 'A man from the Ansar died, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was notified of his death. He said to the one who was next in kinship from his relatives: 'Green your companion.' What is the least of the greened ones? He said: 'A green twig placed from the root of the hands to the collarbone.'

key_terms.التَّخْضِير: The act of placing greenery on the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling and practice of placing greenery on the deceased (Takhdir)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* elucidates the Sunnah of *al-takhdir*, a modest burial practice where a green twig or branch is placed over the chest of the deceased to cover the *awrah*. The narration highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) instruction to the family of an Ansari, emphasizing simplicity and the specific placement from the wrists to the collarbone, which reflects the early community's adherence to modesty in death as well as life.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from Yahya Bin Ubada Al Makky who said,

‘I heard Sufyan Al-Sowry asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the greenery, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A man from the Helpers died and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> advised in his death and he<sup>saww</sup> said to the one who was the closest from his relatives: ‘(Make) greenery (to be with) your companions, and what is the least are two green plants’. He said, ‘And what is the greenery?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A green twig placed at the root of the hands up to the clavicle’ (collarbone).
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘ from Hanan ibn Sadir from Yahya ibn ‘Ubadah al-Makkiy who has said the following:

“I heard Sufyan al-Thawriy asking him (the Imam) about greening. He (the Imam) said that once a man from al-Ansar died and the Messenger of Allah was asked to attend his funeral. He (the Messenger of Allah) asked one of the relatives of the deceased to green up their fellow man; greening people are very few.’ They asked, ‘What is greening?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) replied, ‘It is a fresh twig which is placed near the hands up to the collar bones.’”
